system.description:
Required Weapon: Whip A Vodacce-born style made famous in popular tavern stories, it uses misdirection and precision strikes from a whip.

  • The Flay. When you succeed with Hope on an attack against a lightly armoured target, you may mark a Stress. If you do, your target is temporarily Bleeding - they must mark a Stress every time they take the Spotlight.
  • The Rend. You can mark a stress when attacking a Bleeding target. On a success, you deal Severe damage.
  • The End. When a Bleeding target marks their last HP, you immediately clear one Stress.
